cases.intent: Read often and change priorities without waiting for a provider scan.
cases.acceptance: Seven prepared reads and seven local writes preserve current revisions with one initial provider collection; report service timings without a machine-specific latency gate.

cases.intent: Keep the chosen NOW when another client submits stale state.
cases.acceptance: Exactly one NOW in Focus, stale write rejected, retry replayed without another revision.

cases.intent: Review exactly the response I saw, with Undo.
cases.acceptance: Opening leaves Ready intact; acknowledgement obtains fresh evidence; Undo restores; later responses reappear and old evidence is rejected.

cases.intent: Finish, reopen and continue work in an exact successor chat.
cases.acceptance: Finish clears NOW without auto-promotion and leaves Ready, preserving pending response evidence in History even after a closing reply. Reopen restores review without selecting NOW. Exact continuation preserves predecessor history.

cases.intent: Keep useful saved metadata without claiming stale provider activity.
cases.acceptance: Disk cache is neutral with no live review or commands; account scopes cannot reuse it; priority store excludes titles; cache is owner-readable only.

cases.intent: Use the native widget and Codex plugin interchangeably.
cases.acceptance: The compiled native CLI and MCP tools see shared revisions, preserve concurrent winners, and agree on Finish/Reopen/continuation/history.

cases.intent: Refresh the widget when Codex sends a trusted lifecycle event.
cases.acceptance: The compiled hook wrapper ignores hook-only PLUGIN_DATA, its token reaches the shared reader, no content is stored, and priorities/completion remain unchanged.
